 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. With the last international break of 2027 just around the corner, Borussia Dortmund will hope to enter it on a high as they welcome SV Elversberg to the Westfalenstadion today.
 With kick-off scheduled in around an hour's time at 15:30 CET, both head coaches have officially announced their lineups – you can see them if full detail below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Borussia Dortmund vs. SV Elversberg lineups:
 Borussia Dortmund (4-2-3-1): Kobel – Gadou, Anton, Schlotterbeck, Svensson – Bellingham, Veerman – Karetsas, Nmecha, Chukwuemeka – Silva
 SV Elversberg (4-2-3-1): Kristof – Sirch, Pinkert, Rohr, Günther – Keidel, Poreba – Petkov, Onyeka, Karattenmacher – Mokwa
